feeds.title: Mary's Arthritis
feeds.description: In 2013 I was diagnosed with severe Rheumatoid Arthritis. Next, I was diagnosed with stage three thyroid cancer followed by surgery. The purpose of Mary's Arthritis is to relate my experiences and to share my perspective on this tough illness. It is also to discuss what I have learned about rheumatoid arthritis.

feeds.title: Rheumatoid Arthritis Warrior
feeds.description: Presents patient experiences, news and discussion on rheumatology research. Information and encouragement supporting a rheumatology community since 2009

feeds.title: Getting Closer To Myself
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Dr. Leslie Rott Welsbacher. In April 2008, at the age of 22, I was diagnosed with lupus and rheumatoid arthritis. The Getting Closer To Myself blog is about a lot of things in my life, but focuses on my experiences with illness, in the hopes that my story will help others.

feeds.title: All Flared Up
feeds.description: An Arthritis Blog | Living Rather Than Wallowing | Living Rather Than Wallowing

feeds.title: A Figment Of Fitness
feeds.description: I try to help people to cope with what they have to cope with because to a great degree I've coped with a lot of the same crap. It makes me sad to know that many of the people who are in my world have gotten diagnosed with RA since the point where they came into my world. And, while I don't like knowing that I can answer questions for people who are getting their diagnoses it makes me humble and proud that I can answer them and that I can help them on their journey.

feeds.title: From This Point Forward.
feeds.description: Blog has been a very honest record of how Mariah have adjusted to life with RA by always trying to look forward.

feeds.title: Inflamed: Living with Rheumatoid Arthritis
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Angela. I started this blog in 2007 just as a place to write down my thoughts, frustrations, and inspirations about living with rheumatoid arthritis (RA).

feeds.title: Pollyanna Penguin's RA Blog
feeds.description: This is a blog about me, my recently diagnosed rheumatoid arthritis and my struggles to stay positive about it!

feeds.title: You Don't Look Sick
feeds.description: I was diagnosed with rheumatoid arthritis over 20 years ago but I know I had it for longer. I was lucky that once the symptoms became evident, I was diagnosed quickly and put on medication. So in this blog, I write about my life with rheumatoid arthritis and all that goes along with it. The ups and downs. The highs and lows. The laughter and the tears.

feeds.title: All is Swell
feeds.description: Hello everyone, I'm Peggy Duck! I've started this blog to document my experiences with Rheumatoid Arthritis. I was diagnosed with the autoimmune disease in October of 2013. Living with this condition for more than half of a decade, I continued to learn ways to manage my RA. Besides medications, I firmly believe in the healing power of a positive attitude and routine physical activity. I would like to invite you to share your experiences and advice with me. Together, let's provide encouragement and empower one another in our fight against this chronic disease.
